center.name: The Great Gear
center.description: You stand atop a massive, slowly rotating brass gear. In every direction, the world is a dizzying array of clockwork mechanisms. To the north is a golden gate, and to the south is a descending spiral.

spiral.name: Descending Spiral
spiral.description: A winding staircase of copper plates. The sound of a thousand ticking clocks echoes from below. A small silver key glints in a crack in the wall.

gate.name: The Golden Gate
gate.description: A towering gate of gold and ivory. It has no handle, only a complex series of interlocking slots. To the east is a room of mirrors.

mirrors.name: The Mirror Gallery
mirrors.description: Infinite reflections of yourself stretch into the distance. In the center of the room is a singular, massive lever that seems to control the rotation of the world.

silver_key.name: Silver Key
silver_key.description: A key that feels like it's vibrating in sync with the world.

lever.name: Lever
lever.description: A heavy iron lever. Pulling it feels like shifting the axis of reality.

interactions.message: You pull the lever. A deafening grinding sound fills the air as the entire labyrinth shifts. You hear a satisfying 'CLICK' from the north.
You insert the silver key into the now-aligned slots. The Golden Gate swings open, revealing a blinding white light. YOU HAVE ESCAPED THE CLOCKWORK!
The key doesn't fit. The slots are misaligned. You need to change the rotation of the labyrinth first.
